name: rename-function-across-file
description: Multi-tool workflow: grep to find all occurrences of formatTokens, then edit_file with replace_all to rename them all. Tests grep + edit_file(replace_all) pipeline.
task: In Examples/AgentCLI/main.swift, there is a function called 'formatTokens' that formats token counts for display. Rename this function to 'formatTokenCount' everywhere in the file — both the function definition and all call sites. There are multiple references to find and replace. Make sure you get them all.
